metadata.name: sunhoard
metadata.description: Sunhoard program. Rules live in logic/; instructions call them.

instructions.name: arena_input
docs: Stores the move the next tick will use.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Pays one unclaimed share from the Vault.

instructions.name: crack
docs: Charges the thaw fee and marks the shell. The contents stay hidden.

instructions.name: crack_reveal
docs: Opens a shell that was cracked in an earlier slot. The salt is not logged.

instructions.name: delegate_home
docs: Delegates Village, Arena and View.

instructions.name: delegate_player
docs: Delegates Player, Purse and Inventory. Village, Arena and View are the next transaction.

instructions.name: delegate_shared
docs: Delegates Season, World, Market, PriceBoard and Presence to the given validator.

instructions.name: dungeon_cb
docs: Writes the room seed. The bytes are not logged.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: enter_dungeon
docs: Opens a room, asks the VRF for its seed, and schedules the 100 ms crank.

instructions.name: exit_dungeon
docs: Stops the crank and banks a clear.

instructions.name: gather
docs: Pays the base yield and asks the VRF for the aberration roll.

instructions.name: gather_cb
docs: Adds the aberration, or nothing. The roll is not logged.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: init_game
docs: Creates Season, World, Market, PriceBoard, Presence and the Vault.
Seeds the Vault, tops up the Magic Action escrow, and prefunds permission rent.

instructions.name: init_payout
docs: Creates the season-1 payout record on Solana. It is never delegated.

instructions.name: join
docs: Assigns a player number, gives Nell's bound block, and locks Purse and View.

instructions.name: post_position
docs: Writes Player and Presence when the move fits the combat speed.

instructions.name: record_payout
docs: Writes the SOL split from the committed damage table.

instructions.name: salt_cb
docs: Writes the salt into World. The bytes are not logged.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: set_permissions_shared
docs: World becomes private with no members. The other shared accounts stay public.

instructions.name: settle_season
docs: Commits Season and schedules the payout record. Old Gloam's HP must be 0.

instructions.name: sign_up
docs: Creates the six player accounts and prefunds Purse and View permission rent.

instructions.name: start_season
docs: Asks the VRF for the season salt. The callback opens season 1.

instructions.name: tick_arena
docs: Advances one fixed step when at least 8 slots have passed.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.msg: That action is not available yet.
